machine.note: This is the host that invoked the runner. GitHub `ubuntu-latest` / `macos-latest` weekly cron is not a named fixed benchmark machine (Issue #8 §8.2 / #12).

invariants.name: text_compositor_transform_shapes_nothing
invariants.note: The Runtime measured no text node again: nothing about what any label says changed.

invariants.name: text_compositor_transform_lays_out_nothing
invariants.note: No paragraph was laid out again, by the Runtime or by the painter.

invariants.name: text_compositor_transform_paint_lays_out_nothing
invariants.note: The painter drew every label from a layout it already held.

invariants.name: text_compositor_transform_rasterizes_nothing
invariants.note: No glyph bitmap was produced: the text and its size are what they were.

invariants.name: text_compositor_transform_uploads_no_atlas_region
invariants.note: No atlas region reached the GPU.

invariants.name: text_compositor_transform_rebuilds_no_entry
invariants.note: Every label was answered by its retained entry; none was resolved again.

invariants.name: text_compositor_transform_answers_nodes_from_entries
invariants.note: Nodes that reached a draw without resolving a glyph. Missing stays not-evaluable and must never be read as 0.

scenario.notes: Issue #98 compositor-only gate. The list holding a thousand labels turns -1.5, 0 and +1.5 degrees in turn, so it enters and leaves the identity every third frame: the switch between a translated and a projected run. A transform is presentation: no shape, no layout, no raster, no atlas upload, no instance rebuild. Work counters are the gate; the timings are host observation. Not Issue #8 weekly DoD and has no Iced/GPUI analog.

mapping_notes: Loaded perf/scenarios/gpu-scene-text-compositor-transform.json and materialized its UiOnly params (viewport, host_texture slot, ui_nodes, node_repeat).
RuntimeDocument flush + HostTexture content slot + SceneWgpuPainter encode/submit. Not a private hosted-gpu-demo tree. No CPU readback.
gpu_upload_bytes counts observed queue.write_buffer on that path. NanaRenderer::text atlas uploads are reported separately as glyph_upload_bytes, not estimated into this one.
Batch / GpuUpload / Encode / Submit are FrameProfiler status=ran on the same encode/submit. Runtime-only drains keep those stages unsupported and omit GPU keys.
text_counters are per sampled frame: what one frame asked the retained-text path to resolve, rebuild and upload again.
